_comment:
Master Mobile Plan (2026) > Updates (coverage_matrix.csv XLSX Tab 'Updates', 2.49 grab-bag section) > 'Setup 2' - 'Set CommCare Version = test+1'. This is the Updates(2.49)-tab's OWN Setup 2 row, distinct from the Prompted Updates tab's 'Setup 2' ('Mark latest build In Test + install prior released build + login', see hq_setup/prompted_updates/ for that one - handled separately). This row configures HQ's 'Manage Update Settings' tab (PromptSettingsUpdateView / update_prompts/<app_id>/) so the CommCare (APK) version being prompted-to is exactly one version ahead of whatever version is currently under test ('test+1'), which is a precondition for the 'Prompted Update Scenario 1/2' rows on this same tab (optional/forced CommCare update prompts) to have a real target version to prompt toward.

UPDATE (2026-08-24), per direct user-supplied app link (https://www.commcarehq.org/a/qateam/apps/view/8a04cdf1b9474ee2b090b1d7896b1bd7/) + screen recording: app_id switched to '[Master] Basic Tests NS Copy' (app_registry.py's BASIC_TESTS_NS_COPY entry) - a dedicated copy so this row's own apk_version mutation doesn't collide with every other flow in this repo that installs the shared 'Basic Tests' app expecting its normal, unmutated update-prompt state.

apk_version FINALLY genuinely resolved (3rd correction, same day): the real blocker was never the field's own validation - it's that alpha/dev/pre-release CommCare versions ('2.63.2/latest', '2.64.0/latest', '2.65.0/latest', etc.) are only rendered as visible <option> choices in the Manage Update Settings dropdown for a SUPERUSER account, confirmed live by comparing the regular web-user's dropdown (128 options, tops out at 2.63.1/latest) against the same page loaded with a real superuser session cookie (131 options, including 2.64.0/latest 'alpha' and 2.65.0/latest 'dev'). The earlier '2.65.0/dev' value (rejected as a real fix in the prior UPDATE below) was a red herring that happened to pass form validation without being a real, working target. '2.65.0/latest' is the genuine, UI-confirmed value - and confirmed live that the regular (non-superuser) web-user account CAN write it via this same set_prompt_update_settings POST once its CSRF cookie is properly primed (a real, separate bug in hq_client.py's login() cookie escape-hatch path, fixed the same day - see that function's own UPDATE) - the visibility restriction is template/rendering-only, not a write-permission gate. No superuser credentials are needed for actual test dispatches, only for the one-time discovery of what to set.

Historical note (2026-08-21/24, superseded): apk_version was first left as a placeholder (dropdown seemingly capped at 2.63.1), then briefly (wrongly) set to '2.65.0/dev' and treated as a working fix before being disproven live (5 real login attempts over 12 minutes on scenario_01 never triggered the prompt) - both now resolved by the superuser-dropdown discovery above.

UPDATE (2026-08-24, per direct user instruction): '2.65.0/latest' was itself still a hardcoded literal that goes stale the moment the next CommCare release ships (today's actual latest release is already 2.64.0, one version past this file's own '2.63.x ceiling' framing) - the dropdown's dev/alpha label is what should be selected dynamically, not a specific number. Switched apk_version to hq_client.py's DEV_APK_VALUE sentinel ('AUTO_DEV_BUILD'), resolved at run_pre_step() time via find_dev_apk_version(app_id) against the '(dev)'-labeled <option> - needs a superuser session (see that method's docstring), which per direct user confirmation this domain's existing HQ_SESSION_COOKIE/HQ_API_USERNAME+PASSWORD already are - no separate credential required. The device's own installed CommCare version is left to the normal, already-dynamic default dispatch path (scripts/run_suite.py's download_apk.resolve() with no --apk/--release-tag override, same as every other flow) rather than pinned here - do not hardcode a device-side version either.

UPDATE (2026-08-24): this app_id is shared with other updates_2_49 flows (auto_cc_update_03_relogin_sync_latest_version.yaml, auto_cc_update_daily_preset.json) that assume no update is pending and a normal target version - hq_setup/updates_2_49/prompted_update_scenario_teardown.json restores apk_prompt/app_prompt to 'off' and apk_version back to the actual under-test release afterward. Always run the teardown after prompted_update_scenario_01/02 (scripts/run_suite.py's --hq-teardown does this automatically, even on failure).
